findings.description: Ratio cap is documented as an EXCLUSIVE upper bound ('Exclusive upper bound on ratio. Max settable ratio is MAX_RATIO - 1', line 23; 'Strictly < MAX_RATIO', line 42; '@param newRatio Must be strictly less than MAX_RATIO (50)', line 76), but the guard is `if (newRatio > MAX_RATIO) revert` (line 78), which admits newRatio == 50. DEFAULT_RATIO is also 50 (== MAX_RATIO), so the deployed default already violates the stated 'strictly <' invariant. To honour the documented exclusive bound the guard must be `>=`. Effective behaviour is inclusive-50 while the spec says max 49.
missingMitigations: guard uses > where >= is required for the documented exclusive bound
findings.impact: Owner-set config bound only; ratio can be 50% vs the documented 49% ceiling, and default is already 50%. Owner is trusted (Law 3), so this is a QA/Low spec-deviation, not an exploit. No unbacked mint (debt is still backed by dispatched value). Flagged for report accuracy / doc-code reconciliation.
findings.note: Sibling UniboostMintDebtHook.sol:97 has the IDENTICAL mismatch (MAX_RATIO=50, DEFAULT_RATIO=50, '> MAX_RATIO' guard, 'strictly less than' doc). NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook is INCONSISTENT with these two but internally CONSISTENT: it documents an INCLUSIVE [0,200] bound and its guard matches — no bug there. Contrast confirms the Balancer/Uniboost pair is the accidental case.

manualReview.description: phUSD mint-debt accrues in onDispatch() (gated to dispatcher) and is realised by pull() minting exactly mintDebt to recipient then zeroing. Signatures match (mint(, IMintable, phUSD). Single-writer path, CEI + nonReentrant, ratio-bounded, floor rounding to protocol — structurally the safe shape. Routed for manual/sanitizer reconciliation against DEDUP-001 (unbacked-phUSD) because NudgeRatchetDelayRelease decouples debt-accrual (dispatch time) from USDC custody (held until release()), the documented-but-load-bearing 'backing exists on the contract' assumption. NudgeRatchet.sol:97 now carries the `require(bal >= amount)` tripwire (prior Q-11).
missingMitigations: none code-side; backing-existence is a documented/accepted invariant, not enforced on-chain
manualReview.note: Applies to all three mint-debt hooks (Balancer/Nudge/Uniboost) + NudgeRatchetDelayRelease custody window. Extensive NatSpec marks the debt/custody decoupling as intended/accepted. Sanitizer to reconcile against DEDUP-001; keep the bal>=amount tripwire (Q-11) SEPARATE and do not escalate as speculation (per memory).

manualReview.type: ERC1155 receive-hook reentrancy (no guard on minter)
manualReview.description: _mint(recipient, id, 1, "") invokes onERC1155Received on a caller-controlled recipient. NFTMinterV2 has NO nonReentrant guard on the mint path. Signatures match (_mint(, ERC1155, onERC1155Received). However CEI is followed: config.price is bumped and the dispatch (itself nonReentrant on ATokenDispatcherV2) completes BEFORE _mint; _mint is the final state-mutating op and there is no per-wallet/supply cap to violate. A reentrant mint simply performs another fully-paid mint. Routed low-confidence: no broken-accounting path found, but a minting contract with an inbound ERC1155 hook and no reentrancy guard warrants a human second look.
missingMitigations: no nonReentrant on _executeMint/mintFor (relies on CEI + inner dispatch guard)
manualReview.note: notVulnerableWhen largely holds (all state written before the safe-mint; no cap checked-before-written). Flag is recall-driven (Law 1), not a demonstrated exploit.

manualReview.description: pool() executes two spot swaps (prime->pair, ~half pair->target) then addLiquidity on a UniV2 pool — classic sandwichable buy-and-pool. Signatures match (swap*, balanceOf(address(this))). MITIGATED: caller is onlyAuthorizedPooler (keeper), and minPairOut/minTargetOut/minLP are keeper-supplied slippage floors; addLiquidity min amounts are 0 but bounded by the two swap floors + minLP. Deadline is block.timestamp (no forward deadline). Maps to the known L-06 Low; routed for triage, not re-escalation.
missingMitigations: deadline == block.timestamp (no real deadline); addLiquidity min amounts hardcoded 0 (indirectly bounded by swap floors + minLP)
manualReview.note: Known L-06 per project ledger/memory (run-13/run-14). amountIn param is MEV-neutral-to-beneficial. Do not re-escalate above Low without a new exploit path.

manualReview.relatedPatternId: L-11 (known Low, MultiPooler same-pool in-batch floor staleness)
manualReview.type: batch forwarder loop / in-batch floor staleness
manualReview.description: pool(PoolCall[] calldata calls) loops forwarding one Uniboost.pool per row. Signature matches the unbounded-loop shape, but the array is supplied by the single onlyPooler keeper (not permissionless) and gas is the caller's own concern, so DoS is self-inflicted (not a finding). The real residual is the known L-11 footgun: batching multiple rows that target the SAME Uniboost lets an early row move the pool so later same-pool rows execute against a stale min-out the keeper computed pre-batch. Routed to L-11.
missingMitigations: no in-batch dedup/refresh of per-row min-outs when two rows hit the same Uniboost
manualReview.note: Known L-11 (run-14, primary self-DoS / keeper footgun). Pattern DB has no precise signature for the staleness class; flagged heuristically so the sanitizer reconciles to L-11 rather than dropping.

regressionAnchorsChecked.detail: Three keccak256("NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.v1") literals byte-identical: NudgeRatchet.sol:31, NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.sol:52, NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.sol:31. Both ratchet dispatchers hard-require hook.hookTypeId() == EXPECTED_HOOK_TYPE_ID in _dispatch, reverting on missing/wrong hook. M-04 fail-open dispatch is closed. No drift.

regressionAnchorsChecked.anchor: M-03 decimal scaling (1e12 under-mint / sign-flip over-mint trap)
regressionAnchorsChecked.detail: NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook USDC_TO_PHUSD_SCALE = 1e12 with (amount * 1e12 * ratio)/100 — correct 6dp->18dp direction, not 1e30. UniboostMintDebtHook scale = 10**(18-decimals) read from primeToken (1e12 for 6dp, 1 for 18dp). BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook applies NO scale — correct, USDS is 18dp. All multiply-then-divide, floor to protocol. No under-mint and no over-mint sign-flip.
